title: AI Accelerators & GPUs Expert at Anthropic Believes Established Players Will Dominate the Growing Inference Silicon Market
expert: AI compute specialist at Anthropic (current; ex-Tenstorrent); oversees compute procurement and optimization; no NVIDIA order or fill-rate data; interview 2026-08-12
verdict: An Anthropic compute specialist sees NVIDIA GPU rental at almost 2x the cost of TPU/Trainium for comparable inference and expects workloads to reach 80% inference / 20% training within ~3 years, where NVIDIA faces the steepest price competition (interview dated 2026-08-12).

Compute share vs. XPU/ASIC: 🔴 **NVIDIA GPU rental "almost double" TPU/Trainium cost** (observed platform pricing); first read on GPU-vs-ASIC rental ratio. → Tenet 3 (~75% share) ↓
🔴 **2.8T-parameter Kimi K3 fits on eight AMD chips but not eight GB200** (estimate); matches MI355X ~2x B200 perf/\$ on Kimi K3 (SB #65425). → Tenet 3 (~75% share) ↓
Duration of the AI capex cycle: 🟢 **Inference/training ~50/50 now, heading to 80/20 in ~3 years** (estimate), vs 60%-70% inference in the 2026-11-05 IT-services call. → Tenet 2 (inference-led) ↑
Inference scale (GPU vs specialised chip: 🟡 **Frontier labs at 100 million users/day still suit GPUs**; specialised inference chips may get only 5% or a few single-digit % of lab fleets (estimate). → Tenet 3 (~75% share) →
